fields.acceptance: run-status.txtar with a journal where a check's cycle 1 failed and cycle 2 is open prints 'open in cycle 2 (cycle 1 failed)' and --json has an empty outcome for it; a Go test of the live app's checks summary counts it running; a run summary test heads it open
fields.statement: A review check whose latest cycle is open reads as open, not as its previous cycle's outcome: run status text says 'open in cycle N (cycle N-1 failed)', its JSON outcome is empty, the live app counts it running and run summary heads it open
